mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Area High School, under a waxing crescent moon.

The Verona Common Council has adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide future growth, and the city has also been busy updating engineering services and maintaining strong community infrastructure projects.

We have a busy schedule today and tomorrow. Today, you can join Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the lineup includes the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia events at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.

Regarding the weekly report, on October 3, a 19-year-old Verona man was arrested following a stolen firearm investigation after an officer performed a traffic stop on a vehicle with expired registration.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake and Culver's is currently open until 10:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
